national_indicator_definition: The poverty gap at the USD 8.30 per day poverty line (2021 purchasing power parity) measures the average shortfall in income or consumption from that poverty line across the population, with a shortfall of zero assigned to people who are not poor. It is expressed as a percentage of the poverty line and reflects the depth of poverty, rather than only the share of the population living below the line.
national_rationale: Monitoring the depth of poverty helps improve understanding of the economic circumstances of people living below the international poverty line. The poverty gap indicates how far, on average, the income or consumption of the population falls below that line, with the entire population included in the calculation. This indicator is used as a proxy for Bosnia and Herzegovina. Data from the Statistics on Income and Living Conditions (SILC) survey are not available in the Eurostat database for reporting EU SDG indicator 1.10, “Persons at risk of poverty or social exclusion”, for Bosnia and Herzegovina. Consequently, values for that indicator cannot be presented according to the harmonised EU methodology. The World Bank indicator provides additional information on the depth of poverty, but it is not directly comparable with the EU SDG indicator and does not measure poverty against Bosnia and Herzegovina’s national poverty line.
national_methodology_characteristics: Data from the World Bank’s Poverty and Inequality Platform are available for selected years between 2001 and 2021. According to the available series, the poverty gap at the USD 8.30 per day threshold was 4.7% in 2001, 2.2% in 2004, 4.3% in 2007 and 2011, 4.9% in 2015, and 2.7% in 2021. Between 2015 and 2021, the indicator decreased by 2.2 percentage points. This indicator describes the depth of poverty relative to the World Bank’s international poverty line. Given the limited frequency of the data and the proxy nature of the indicator, this decrease alone is not sufficient for a reliable assessment of progress towards the official Sustainable Development Goal target.
national_long_objective: No specific quantitative national target has been established for this proxy indicator in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Its interpretation should be based on the indicator’s definition and distinguished from national poverty-reduction measures and targets.
